name: Hitozuma Saiban Toriko
source:
Bianca stops in a certain village on her travels. She has dinner, but then suddenly falls unconscious.
Time passes and Bianca awakens, only to find herself surrounded by the villagers with wicked grins on their faces.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033286.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
碧安卡在旅行中停留在某个村庄。她吃了晚餐，然后突然失去了意识。时间流逝，碧安卡醒来时，发现自己被满脸邪恶笑容的村民们包围着。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033286.html]DLsite[/url]]
